summary.text: Gu Immortals reach the mid-tier immortal rank at rank seven, one step above rank six. Its immortal aperture is still a blessed land, and its immortal essence is red date.

claims.text: A rank six Gu Immortal and a rank seven Gu Immortal can stand together in one household as distinct immortal cultivation levels.
Immortal apertures of rank six and rank seven Gu Immortals are blessed lands; rank eight and rank nine apertures are grotto-heavens.
A rank seven blessed land produces red date immortal essence, one rank higher than green grape immortal essence.

Advancement to rank seven runs on a fixed clock: a rank six Gu Immortal endures an earthly calamity once each decade, with the calamity due every hundredth year escalating into a heavenly tribulation instead. Once three of those tribulations have passed, at the three-hundred-year mark, the Gu Immortal steps up to rank seven.

Gu Immortals at rank six are considered bottom tier and numerous. Gu Immortals at rank seven are mid-tier, the elites among Gu Immortals with high status. One hundred beads of green grape immortal essence can merge into a bead of red date immortal essence. Using green grape immortal essence to activate rank seven Immortal Gu costs at least thirty percent additional expenditure; red date immortal essence avoids that loss.
Gu Immortals at rank seven face an earthly calamity every ten years, a heavenly tribulation every fifty years, and a grand tribulation every one hundred years.
The cultivator class from rank six up is covered on Gu Immortal. The wider ladder is covered on ranks and realms.
